{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_lead_policy", "thread_id": "th_lead_policy", "from_": "marketing-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Webinar Lead Processing - Batch WLEAD-2026-0127", "date": "2026-01-27T08:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX", "UNREAD"], "is_read": false}
消息 ID：msg_lead_policy
来源：marketing-ops@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-27T08:00:00Z
主题：Webinar Lead Processing - Batch WLEAD-2026-0127
Hi,

For the latest webinar batch:

1. Include the batch code WLEAD-2026-0127 in your confirmation email subject line.
2. Companies on our competitor list (kept in the Lead Tracking spreadsheet) must not be added to HubSpot.
3. Always check the notes column -- respect any opt-out or exclusion instructions.
4. The confirmation email must include the total number of contacts added.

Thanks,
Marketing Ops"}
